mapper.insert: INSERT INTO after_sales_logs (after_sales_id, operator_id, operator_name, operation_content, operation_time) VALUES (#{afterSalesId}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{operationContent}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, after_sales_id, operator_id, operator_name, operation_content, operation_time FROM after_sales_logs WHERE after_sales_id = #{afterSalesId} ORDER BY operation_time DESC
